title: Intermittent latency spikes on checkout flow
description: Transient latency spikes reported by end users intermittently. Probe telemetry shows healthy snapshot metrics across all components.

hypotheses.name: Incorrect payment endpoint
hypotheses.description: Configuration drift or stale cached DNS entry.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Verify DNS TTL values and flush client connection pool caches.

hypotheses.name: Payment provider outage
hypotheses.description: Intermittent packet loss or throttling on payment provider gateway.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Enable detailed debug tracing on outbound payment calls to capture transient network packet loss.

hypotheses.name: Database failure
hypotheses.description: Periodic garbage collection or background vacuum causing lock stalls.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Profile database autovacuum schedule and monitor lock wait times during peak intervals.

evidence.observation: Intermittent 99th percentile latency alert fired twice in the last hour, then recovered.
2 users reported slow checkout page load; subsequent retries succeeded.
